mapper.select: SELECT id FROM kpi_definition WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpi_value_history (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at, archived_at) SELECT kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at, NOW() FROM kpi_value WHERE kpi_id = #{kpiId} AND dimension = #{dimensionJson}::jsonb
mapper.update: INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN page_url ~ '^/features?/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0 ), 4) AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, COUNT(*)::numeric AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'EXPORT' AND event_time >= #{targetDate}::date AND event_time < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = #{tableName}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::numeric AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' AND user_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::numeric AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', #{targetDate}::date) AND created_at < date_trunc('month', #{targetDate}::date) + INTERVAL '1 month' AND user_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, jsonb_build_object('date', #{targetDateText}, 'contentType', ct) AS dimension, COUNT(*)::numeric AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN page_url ~ '/notices?/' OR page_url ~ '/board/notice' THEN 'notice' WHEN page_url ~ '/posts?/' OR page_url ~ '/board/(free|qna)' THEN 'post' WHEN page_url ~ '/publications?/' OR page_url ~ '/pub/' THEN 'publication' ELSE NULL END AS ct FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' ) classified WHERE ct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ct ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) WITH ordered AS ( SELECT session_id, created_at, CASE WHEN created_at - LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY created_at) > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' AND session_id IS NOT NULL ), segmented AS ( SELECT session_id, created_at, SUM(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY created_at) AS seg_no FROM ordered ), durations AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(created_at) - MIN(created_at))) AS dur_sec FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id, seg_no ) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(dur_sec), 0), 4)::numeric AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM durations ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, ROUND( COALESCE( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 500)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 0 ), 4) AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: INSERT INTO batch_execution_log (job_name, job_group, started_at, status, triggered_by) VALUES ('KPI_AGGREGATION', 'STATS', #{startedAt}, 'RUNNING', 'SCHEDULE') RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_execution_log SET status = #{status}, finished_at = NOW(), duration_ms = (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_at)) * 1000)::int, records_processed = #{recordsProcessed}, records_failed = #{recordsFailed}, error_summary = #{errorSummary} WHERE id = #{id}
